title: I Found a Perfect Business That Anyone Can Start
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
description:
You will walk away from this video being an expert in 2 things:

1. How to start a profitable firewood business with almost $0.
2. How to sell anything to anyone on Facebook Marketplace.

In this episode, I discuss how to start a firewood business with almost no upfront costs, and sell it on Facebook Marketplace. I explain how to get wood for free from tree trimming companies, and how to prepare the wood using a log splitter and seasoning. I also cover how to create an effective Facebook Marketplace listing, use local Facebook groups for marketing, and use a high traffic location to your advantage. I share how to calculate CPM for free marketing opportunities, and how important it is to consider your target customer when marketing. Finally, I show how two high school students, Cade and Devin, put these steps into action and start a business, called "College Fund Firewood."
